title: At the Cafe
text:
Ana and Tom are at a cafe. Ana says, "Hello, Tom. How are you?" Tom says, "I am fine, thank you." They sit at a table by the window.

Tom wants a coffee. Ana wants a juice. The waiter brings their drinks. Ana smiles and says, "Thank you!" Then they talk and laugh together.

questions.text: How does Ana feel at the end of the passage?
What is the most likely relationship between Ana and Tom?

vocabulary.definition: a small place where you can buy coffee and other drinks
a glass opening in a wall that lets in light
a piece of furniture with a flat top that you sit at

paragraph_translations: Ana y Tom están en una cafetería. Ana dice: "Hola, Tom. ¿Cómo estás?" Tom dice: "Estoy bien, gracias." Ellos se sientan en una mesa junto a la ventana.
Tom quiere un café. Ana quiere un jugo. El mesero trae sus bebidas. Ana sonríe y dice: "¡Gracias!" Luego hablan y se ríen juntos.
